steps.title: Prepare cell culture media mix
steps.instruction: Combine DMEM (88.5%, 500 mL), sodium pyruvate (0.88%, 5 mL), fetal bovine serum (8.85%, 50 mL) and penicillin‑streptomycin (1.77%, 10 mL) to a final volume of 565 mL; store at 2–8 °C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Prepare ECM bottom layer mix
steps.instruction: Mix Geltrex:Laminin 1:1 (10 µL), hEGF (9 µL), cell culture media mix (8 µL) and fetal bovine serum (73 µL) to a total of 100 µL; aliquot and store at –20 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare ECM top layer mix
steps.instruction: Mix Geltrex:Laminin 1:1 (30 µL) with cell culture media mix (270 µL) to a total of 300 µL; aliquot and store at –20 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare VALAP sealing mixture
steps.instruction: Combine petroleum jelly (30 g), paraffin (30 g) and lanolin (30 g) (each 33.3%); heat on a hot plate until liquid, aliquot 1.5 mL into Eppendorf tubes and store at room temperature for up to 2 years.

steps.title: Grow MDA‑MB‑231 to 80‑90% confluence
steps.instruction: Culture ~500 000 MDA‑MB‑231 cells in tissue‑culture‑treated flasks with the cell culture media mix; replace media every 2 days and warm media to 37 °C before use until 80‑90% confluence is reached.

steps.title: Detach and count cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate media, rinse twice with 5 mL 1× PBS, add 1 mL 0.05 % trypsin and incubate 37 °C ≤2 min; add 10 mL media, pipette to detach, transfer to a 15 mL tube, centrifuge 300–500×g 3 min, aspirate, resuspend pellet in 1 mL fresh media, load 10 µL into a hemacytometer, count cells in five squares at 10×, calculate cells / mL (total ÷ 5 × 10 000) and use this value for downstream plating.

steps.title: Plate cells for AIC transfection
steps.instruction: In a 12‑well plate, add ~200 000 cells in 2 mL media per well, including two extra wells for error; each AIC will ultimately receive 150‑200 000 cells.

steps.title: Transfect cells 2 h before assembly
steps.instruction: Transfect the cells in the 12‑well plate with cDNA and Lipofectamine 3000 at a 1:4 ratio (per manufacturer’s protocol); incubate at 37 °C for 4 h (start 2 h before AIC assembly).

steps.title: Prepare ice bath in BSC
steps.instruction: Fill a large sterile ice container with DI‑water ice, leaving 2 inches of space from the top; place the container in the biosafety cabinet and pack the ice smoothly.

steps.title: Thaw ECM mixes on ice
steps.instruction: Place aliquots of the ECM bottom‑layer and top‑layer mixes in the ice container (tubes toward the sides) and allow them to thaw; spray all items with 70 % ethanol before placing them in the BSC.

steps.title: Heat VALAP
steps.instruction: Set a heat block inside the BSC to 121 °C and heat two 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes containing VALAP for approximately 30 min.

steps.title: Place Pyrex dish on ice
steps.instruction: Lay a single large Pyrex Petri‑dish bottom flat on the ice container, ensuring full contact between dish and ice.

steps.title: Cool glass‑bottom dishes
steps.instruction: Place 2–6 (up to 6) 35 mm glass‑bottom dishes on the Pyrex cover and let them cool for ~20 min; avoid excessive condensation which can alter ECM volume.

steps.title: Cut pipette tip for viscous ECM
steps.instruction: Using a razor blade, cut a 10 µL pipette tip about 1/8 inch from the tip; this cut tip will be used each time the Geltrex:Laminin mix is dispensed.

steps.title: Add bottom ECM layer
steps.instruction: Dispense 5 µL of the bottom‑layer mix as a single central drop onto each glass‑bottom dish, immediately return the dish to ice, keep on ice, and let sit ≥5 min before proceeding.

steps.title: Place PETE membrane
steps.instruction: Using tweezers, remove a PETE membrane from its package, keep the edge off the box, and carefully center the membrane on the bottom‑layer drop without moving it afterward.

steps.title: Seal with hot VALAP
steps.instruction: Cut another 10 µL tip 1/8 inch from the tip, dispense hot VALAP (~121 °C) into the tip, and immediately drop VALAP around the membrane edge and the well side wall; hold the dish at ≥45° angle and do not spread VALAP with the tip.

steps.title: Incubate sealed assembly on ice
steps.instruction: Place the membrane‑sealed glass‑bottom dish back on ice for at least 10 min; this stage can be paused as long as the dish remains on ice.

steps.title: Add top ECM layer
steps.instruction: After the 10‑min ice incubation, dispense 6 µL of the top‑layer mix onto each dish using the cut 10 µL tip and spread gently; keep the dish on ice.

steps.title: Refrigerate assembled AICs
steps.instruction: Transfer the Pyrex dish containing the assembled AICs to a 2–8 °C refrigerator for 1 h to stabilize the bottom layer and allow the top layer to spread evenly; the AICs may remain up to 3 h but not longer to avoid dehydration.

steps.title: Cut Parafilm strips
steps.instruction: While the AICs are refrigerating, cut Parafilm into 2 × 6‑inch strips, preparing three strips for each AIC.

steps.title: Wrap AICs with Parafilm
steps.instruction: After the 1‑h incubation, wrap the perimeter of each AIC with the three Parafilm strips, triple‑covering the edge to prevent ECM drying.

steps.title: Incubate AICs at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Place the Parafilm‑wrapped AICs (still in the Pyrex cover) in a 37 °C incubator for at least 30 min.

steps.title: Detach transfected cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate media from the transfected 12‑well plate, rinse twice with 1 mL PBS per well, aspirate, add 500 µL 0.05 % trypsin per well, incubate 37 °C ≤2 min, add 2 mL media, pipette vigorously to detach cells, and transfer the suspension to 15 mL conical tubes.

steps.title: Centrifuge and count cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes, resuspend the pellet in 2 mL media, and count cells using a hemacytometer as described earlier.

steps.title: Plate cells on AIC
steps.instruction: Plate approximately 200 000 cells in 200 µL of final cell‑culture media onto each assembled AIC and incubate for 24 h.

steps.title: Add HEPES before imaging
steps.instruction: Thirty minutes prior to imaging, add HEPES to a final concentration of 35 mM in 2 mL of cell‑culture media.

steps.title: Prepare microscope for imaging
steps.instruction: Heat the microscope stage (air blower or enclosure) to ~37 °C; use a 40×–60× objective with a working distance of at least 310 µm to capture full z‑stacks of invadopodia.
